entry.title: Tokyo Station

groundCutout.basis: Inspected frontage picture supports red brick, three storeys, cream bands, mansard wings and curved octagonal dome assemblies. Standard PMTiles separates the western low-rise combined station building from long platform-roof polygons. Its319m long axis and71.7m combined depth locate an approximate32m-wide western historic-frontage strip; the asset covers this Marunouchi frontage, not all Tokyo Station. Native+X follows the southward frontage axis; native+Z faces the west-northwest plaza. Native source335m length is scaled to the mapped319m frontage reference. Standard PMTiles centre contact plane establishes the approximate working floor; sampled footing corners descend to surrounding grade, and high urban samples beneath the roof are suppressed only under bounded covered architecture. Coarse PMTiles city mounds are retained outside the model and are not claimed as accurate plaza grade. No precise frontage/member survey is claimed.

terrainReference.basis: Standard PMTiles centre contact plane, retained as approximate viewer grade; under-city samples are coarse and are not surveyed street heights.
